purpose: Practical readiness for offline corpus annotation, not proof of error-free labels or training benefit. Frozen before fresh judge calls.
criteria: Every sampled complete trajectory has valid JSON and exact step coverage after bounded transport retries.
No silent truncation; judge the corpus-largest input using the same protocol.
Review all failed evidence checks; mandatory focus on R5 submission exclusion and R6 partial-write retries.
Report repeat consistency and F/non-F switches instead of demanding identical P/N labels.
Identify remaining semantic concerns explicitly; do not relabel raw outputs or treat official success as judge truth.
Full run uses frozen prompt/model/input hashes and local structural validation; no weights or reward synthesis.
